briefing_summary: 本期八个版面聚焦：美国宣布对含中国、欧盟在内的多国加征新关税，巴西称“不可接受”，中国批“毫无依据”；市场在通胀与加息预期间震荡，韩国央行加息并上调增长预期。AI 与技术版面以 arXiv 论文为主，讨论智能体任务/接口能力、长期记忆与评测偏差，均属研究主张。开发与创业版面关注 datasette-charts 标注、sqlite3_rsync 及多款编码、数据智能体。中国版面涵盖中非青年交流、国防部回应菲澳防务协议、广西 AI 出海、主播工伤认定与黑龙江大雪预报。科技与观点版面补充红海卤水池、早期黑洞候选及 Ubuntu 安全响应争议。
briefing_title_en: Daily Briefing, November 26, 2026: Tariff Risk, Agent Evaluations and Market Repricing
briefing_summary_en: The eight-section briefing centers on new US tariffs covering China, the EU and other partners, with Brazil calling the threat unacceptable and China rejecting it as baseless; markets are weighing inflation and rate expectations, while the Bank of Korea raised rates and lifted its growth forecast. AI items are arXiv research claims on agent task/interface competence, long-term memory and evaluation gaps, not settled findings. Developer and startup coverage highlights datasette-charts annotations, sqlite3_rsync and new coding/data agents. China coverage spans China-Africa youth exchanges, the defense ministry on the Philippines-Australia pact, Guangxi AI exports, livestreamer injury claims and Heilongjiang snow warnings. Science and opinion add Red Sea brine pools, a primordial black hole candidate and criticism of Ubuntu security response.

sections.title: AI 与大模型

articles.title: 智能体训练中的“学什么”与“怎么学”：拆解任务能力与接口能力
articles.summary: 论文区分智能体训练中的任务能力与接口能力，指出模型可能掌握任务知识，却因系统提示、动作格式或反馈循环等运行框架不匹配而失败。
articles.title_en: Learning What vs. Learning How: Decomposing Task and Interface Competence in Agentic Training
articles.summary_en: The paper separates task knowledge from interface competence in agentic training, arguing that a model can know a task yet fail under a given harness of prompts, action formats, and feedback loops.
articles.original_title: Learning What vs. Learning How: Decomposing Task and Interface Competence in Agentic Training
articles.reason: 直接讨论智能体运行框架对能力发挥的影响，属于前沿模型训练与评测的重要问题。
articles.reason_en: Directly addresses how agent harnesses shape competence, a key issue for frontier agent training and evaluation.

articles.title: SpatialCraft：让空间推理智能体从经验与技能中演化程序性智能
articles.summary: 论文提出 SpatialCraft，让空间推理智能体从经验与技能中演化程序性智能，以协调 3D 重建、分割和几何计算等外部工具。
articles.title_en: SpatialCraft: Evolving Procedural Intelligence from Experience and Skills for Spatial Reasoning Agents
articles.summary_en: SpatialCraft trains spatial reasoning agents to evolve procedural intelligence from experience and skills, coordinating external tools such as 3D reconstruction, segmentation, and geometric computation.
articles.original_title: SpatialCraft: Evolving Procedural Intelligence from Experience and Skills for Spatial Reasoning Agents
articles.reason: 聚焦多模态智能体的工具编排瓶颈，方法具体，适合前沿模型版。
articles.reason_en: Focuses on the tool-orchestration bottleneck for multimodal agents with a concrete method, fitting frontier model coverage.

articles.title: MGMem：面向长期智能体记忆的高效、确定且可追溯框架
articles.summary: 论文提出 MGMem，一种高效、确定且保留来源的长期智能体记忆框架，避免反复调用生成模型改写历史带来的高成本。
articles.title_en: MGMem: An Efficient, Deterministic, and Provenance-Preserving Framework for Long-Horizon Agent Memory
articles.summary_en: MGMem is an efficient, deterministic, and provenance-preserving memory framework for long-horizon agents, avoiding the high cost of repeatedly invoking generative models to rewrite interaction history.
articles.original_title: MGMem: An Efficient, Deterministic, and Provenance-Preserving Framework for Long-Horizon Agent Memory
articles.reason: 长期记忆是智能体落地的关键组件，论文给出成本与可追溯性兼顾的框架。
articles.reason_en: Long-term memory is a key agent component; the paper offers a framework balancing cost and provenance.

articles.title: 大语言模型中的外在认知负荷：呈现方式也会影响表现
articles.summary: 论文借用认知负荷理论，考察大语言模型是否也会因任务信息的呈现方式产生“外在认知负荷”，从而影响解题表现。
articles.title_en: Extraneous Cognitive Load in Large Language Models
articles.summary_en: Borrowing from Cognitive Load Theory, the paper examines whether large language models exhibit extraneous cognitive load, where how task information is presented alone affects problem-solving performance.
articles.original_title: Extraneous Cognitive Load in Large Language Models
articles.reason: 把认知负荷理论用于分析模型表现，提供提示设计与评测的新视角。
articles.reason_en: Applies cognitive load theory to model behavior, offering a new lens on prompt design and evaluation.

articles.title: REI：从代码仓库演化中学习创意生成
articles.summary: 论文提出 REI，从代码仓库演化中学习科研与工程创意生成，以缓解 AI 自动实验系统中“想法稀疏、验证昂贵”的瓶颈。
articles.title_en: REI: Learning Ideation from Repository Evolution
articles.summary_en: REI learns ideation from repository evolution to ease the bottleneck in automated AI experimentation, where useful ideas are sparse and validation is costly.
articles.original_title: REI: Learning Ideation from Repository Evolution
articles.reason: 针对 AI 自动科研中的创意瓶颈提出学习方法，问题明确。
articles.reason_en: Targets the ideation bottleneck in automated scientific iteration with a learning approach.

articles.title: MOZAIC：区分面部、声音与编码痕迹的音视频深度伪造基准
articles.summary: 论文发布 MOZAIC 音视频深度伪造基准，用四类配对标签区分伪造面部、声音或两者，以判断检测器依赖图像、语音还是编码痕迹。
articles.title_en: MOZAIC: An Audio-Video Deepfake Benchmark for Telling What Is Fake
articles.summary_en: MOZAIC is a paired audio-video deepfake benchmark with four-way labels that separates fake faces, voices, or both, helping reveal whether detectors rely on images, speech, or encoding traces.
articles.original_title: MOZAIC: An Audio-Video Deepfake Benchmark for Telling What Is Fake
articles.reason: 深度伪造检测需要更细粒度基准，MOZAIC 的标签设计直接针对检测依据。
articles.reason_en: Deepfake detection needs finer-grained benchmarks; MOZAIC’s label design directly probes detector reliance.

articles.title: 超越静态图表：面向多模态大模型的交互式图表转代码基准
articles.summary: 论文提出面向多模态大模型的交互式图表转代码基准，弥补现有评测只覆盖静态图表、忽视可交互数据探索的不足。
articles.title_en: Beyond Static Charts: Benchmarking Interactive Chart-to-Code Generation for MLLMs
articles.summary_en: The paper introduces a benchmark for interactive chart-to-code generation by multimodal LLMs, filling a gap left by evaluations that cover only static charts and ignore interactive data exploration.
articles.original_title: Beyond Static Charts: Benchmarking Interactive Chart-to-Code Generation for MLLMs
articles.reason: 图表转代码是 MLLM 的实用能力，交互式评测补足现有空白。
articles.reason_en: Chart-to-code is a practical MLLM capability, and interactive evaluation fills an existing gap.

articles.title: 失落在翻译而非置信度：多语言决策模型的评测与校准
articles.summary: 论文在 14 种语言、17 项任务上评测 25 个开源决策模型，检验多语言路由与护栏模型在非英语环境下的表现与置信度校准。
articles.title_en: Lost in Translation, Not in Confidence: Benchmarking and Calibrating Multilingual Decision Models
articles.summary_en: The study evaluates 25 open-weight decision models across 17 tasks in 14 languages, probing how multilingual routers and guardrails perform and calibrate outside English.
articles.original_title: Lost in Translation, Not in Confidence: Benchmarking and Calibrating Multilingual Decision Models
articles.reason: 决策模型被路由器和护栏直接阈值化使用，多语言校准评测具有治理意义。
articles.reason_en: Decision models are thresholded directly by routers and guardrails, making multilingual calibration evaluation governance-relevant.

articles.title: 用交互式二维环境归因视觉语言智能体的失败
articles.summary: 论文用交互式二维环境归因视觉语言智能体的失败，区分误读环境、不理解组件、操作顺序错误和无法纠错等不同原因。
articles.title_en: Attributing Agentic Failure in Reasoning Vision-Language Models with Interactive 2D Environments
articles.summary_en: Using interactive 2D environments, the paper attributes failures of reasoning vision-language agents to distinct causes such as misreading the environment, misunderstanding components, wrong ordering, and failure to recover.
articles.original_title: Attributing Agentic Failure in Reasoning Vision-Language Models with Interactive 2D Environments
articles.reason: 把智能体成功率拆解为可诊断的失败类型，有助于评测与改进。
articles.reason_en: Decomposes agent success rates into diagnosable failure types, aiding evaluation and improvement.

articles.title: 当知识不够用：语言模型处理部分覆盖问题的试点评测
articles.summary: 论文试点评估语言模型在参考资料只覆盖问题一部分时的回答表现，指出以往评测常把“部分足够”的上下文简单视为“不足”。
articles.title_en: When the Knowledge Runs Out: A Part-Level Pilot Evaluation of How Language Models Handle Partially Covered Questions
articles.summary_en: This pilot evaluation examines how language models answer when reference material covers only part of a question, noting that prior evaluations often treat partially sufficient context as simply insufficient.
articles.original_title: When the Knowledge Runs Out: A Part-Level Pilot Evaluation of How Language Models Handle Partially Covered Questions
articles.reason: 部分覆盖是检索增强应用的常见情形，评测设计有实际价值。
articles.reason_en: Partial coverage is common in retrieval-augmented applications, making the evaluation design practically useful.
